scope: Original photographed costume combination; none of these relations is a universal color, body-proportion or exposure definition, and no existing named character is being copied.
future_opt_in_rule: Only compatible post-core optional concepts selected by this arm may become runtime hard obligations. This record alone creates no anchor, assertion, visual intent or render gate.

relations.observable_relation: Two long side hair sections descend from two separate angular roots behind and above the ears.
relations.baseline_evidence: Dusty-violet twin tails descend from two angular clips above and behind the ears, their long sections falling behind her arms

relations.observable_relation: Separate housings sit over both ears and one slim boom remains attached to the left housing with its tip beside the mouth.
relations.baseline_evidence: Copper headset housings sit over both ears; a slim boom from the housing on her left ends beside the corner of her mouth

relations.observable_relation: A standing collar tops a sleeveless fitted bodice and a distinct narrow tie runs down the front center, stopping above the belt.
relations.baseline_evidence: A graphite sleeveless fitted bodice rises into a standing collar, with a narrow copper tie laid down its center and ending above the belt

relations.observable_relation: Sleeve tops sit below the shoulders with visible upper-arm intervals and their cuffs end before the acting hands.
relations.baseline_evidence: Detached long sleeves begin below the shoulders, exposing distinct upper-arm intervals; squared wrist cuffs finish before her hands

relations.observable_relation: A waist belt carries a fan-pleated short overskirt and a side module whose tab is being fastened at the front.
relations.baseline_evidence: A belt supports a short fan-pleated overskirt and a translucent side panel curving toward a front buckle

relations.observable_relation: Tall boot shafts end on the thighs below the skirt hem with visible intervening leg intervals, while both soles contact the floor.
relations.baseline_evidence: Graphite boots rise to mid-thigh, leaving a visible leg interval between each boot top and the skirt hem
